title: PoliceTakedownRequestLogRecord
description: Standard schema for individual police content takedown and data requests dispatched to social media platforms.

request_id.description: Unique identifier for the request (e.g. SYN-REQ-2026-0001 or police ref).

is_synthetic.description: Indicates whether this record is synthetic demonstration data. MUST be true for public demos and tests.

request_type.description: Type of request dispatched: content removal vs user/IP data request.

platform.description: Name of the target intermediary/platform. Fictional identities (Platform A..J) MUST be used for synthetic data.

category.description: Legal or harm classification of the incident.

priority.description: Request urgency level dictating expected response SLA.

legal_route.description: Statutory or procedural route governing the request (e.g. Rule 3(1)(d), Rule 3(2)(b)).

sent_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when request was formally transmitted to the platform.

acknowledged_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when platform confirmed receipt of the request.

claimed_removal_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when platform claimed the content was removed or access disabled.

data_provided_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when platform fulfilled user/metadata data request.

police_unit_id.description: Anonymized or official police division/station code (e.g., UNIT-KL-CYBER-01).

is_complete_request.description: True if request satisfied all formal legal/procedural prerequisites (e.g. valid order, explicit URL, jurisdiction).

incompletion_reason.description: Reason documented if the request was incomplete or procedurally deficient.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the request.

rejection_reason.description: Platform-provided justification if the request was rejected (e.g. Overbroad, OutsideJurisdiction).

content_url_hmac.description: HMAC-SHA-256 identifier of the content URL computed with authorized secret key. RAW URLS MUST NEVER BE STORED.

content_url_hash.description: Backward-compatibility alias for URL hash identifier.
